title: fix(auth)!: createAuthClient().updateUser declares a void result, matching better-auth's receipt
body:
Fixes #36987

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

> **BREAKING** (published typing, shipped as `patch`): `AuthClient.updateUser` in `@object-ui/auth` now resolves `Promise<void>` instead of `Promise<AuthUser>`. Callers that read the result, and hosts that implement `AuthClient` and pass it as `AuthProviderOptions.client` with an `updateUser` that returns a user, no longer type-check; read the session instead / return nothing. Runtime behaviour that ever worked is unchanged (the server always answered `{ status: true }`).

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改了认证包对外声明的返回类型，界面和资料保存的表现都不变。
- 为什么做：认证包对外说"改资料后会交回用户"，实际服务器只回一个"成功"回执，对外的说明和实际对不上。
- 出错会怎样：只影响直接调用这个接口的外部代码，它们改读会话即可；改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：裁定 ADR-0087 处置类别（门禁没有适合「具体类型收窄」的类别），之后批准合并（申报收窄，Tier H）。

## What changes

Arm (a): the declaration now says what the call returns. `AuthClient.updateUser` in `@object-ui/auth` was declared as a `Promise` of `AuthUser`. It is now a `Promise` of `void`, and `createAuthClient().updateUser` resolves with nothing instead of handing on better-auth's answer.

- FROM `(data: Partial of AuthUser) => Promise of AuthUser` TO `(data: Partial of AuthUser) => Promise of void`.
- Premise measured on `origin/main` (da7c559990): better-auth 1.7.12 `dist/api/routes/update-user.mjs` ends `/update-user` with `ctx.json({ status: true })` (line 75). `plugin-auth` passes the route through unchanged (`auth-route-ledger.ts`, disposition `sdk`). The client cast that receipt to `AuthUser` and returned it.
- Why (a) and not (b), where (b) means returning a real user with one more session read:
  - Census of every `updateUser` reader under `ui/` and `apps/`: the only in-repo caller of the client method is `AuthProvider.updateUser`. It awaits the call and ignores the result (since #36984), and builds the session user itself. `AuthContext.updateUser` and `useAuth().updateUser` already resolve with nothing. `ProfilePage` calls `useAuth().updateUser` and never reads a result. No reader needs the user.
  - With (b), every profile write would cost one more round trip to fetch a user that nobody reads. `updateUser` would also be the only write on `AuthClient` that returns the entity. `changePassword`, `setInitialPassword`, `verifyTotp` and the other writes all resolve with nothing.
  - `@objectstack/client` already types the same route as a status receipt (`AuthStatusReceipt`, pinned in `return-type-precision.test.ts`). (a) brings the two published clients into agreement about what the server answers.
- A refusal still rejects, as before. The `no data` guard stays.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/auth` patch with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, a `**BREAKING**` banner and the FROM → TO line (AGENTS.md step 3: a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its banner). The ADR-0087 disposition marker is pending a maintainer ruling: no category the gate admits fits a concrete-to-concrete narrowing of a published TS member.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`, the `updateUser` hunk: the runtime change (returns nothing).
2. `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts`, the `AuthClient.updateUser` declaration: the published typing.
3. `.changeset/36987-auth-updateuser-returns-void.md`: the FROM → TO wording for external callers.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/updateUser-return-36987.test.ts` has two pins. The type pin checks that `ReturnType` of `AuthClient['updateUser']` and of `createAuthClient()`'s `updateUser` both equal a `Promise` of `void` (held by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, the package's `type-check`). The runtime pin checks that `{ status: true }` from the wire resolves to `undefined`.
- The existing `createAuthClient.test.ts` case used to stub `/update-user` with a `{ user }` body the server never sends and assert `result.name`. It now stubs the real receipt and asserts that the call resolves with `undefined`.

<details><summary>Package tests, type-check and build (eb995f6493)</summary>

- Closure build under the verify lock: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/auth^...' build`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth test && pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth build`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Tests: `Test Files 51 passed (51)`, `Tests 525 passed (525)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse validation and ablation (one-off, no test file kept)</summary>

- Type leg: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` restored the old declaration in `types.ts` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 2d83741e → 5b271b75). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` then exited 2 with TS2344 on both type pins (lines 22 and 24) and TS2322 on the client implementation. After restore, `git diff HEAD` was empty and the blob matched HEAD (2d83741e).
- Runtime leg: `return data as never;` was put back into `updateUser` (anchor 1 → 0, blob b9de0b71 → 344fbc7c). vitest went red on both runtime pins: `Tests 2 failed | 42 passed (44)`, `AssertionError: expected { status: true } to be undefined`. It was restored (blob == HEAD b9de0b71, `git diff HEAD` empty). The first runtime attempt was a no-op, because its replacement contained the anchor (count 1 → 1). The tool refused that attempt and restored the file, and the leg was rerun with a different anchor.
- Both tests import from source, so no `dist/` was in the path.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `AuthProvider.test.tsx` (line 32) and `LoginForm.test.tsx` (line 33) mock clients still resolve `updateUser` with a user object. Nothing reads that value, so no test depends on it, and both files are outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families (eb995f6493)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 39 families. 38 ran locally, each `exit 0`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, reason: the ui scripts suite needs the whole ui tree built. The `@objectstack/formula` entry did not resolve, and the forks-pool date-zone pins ran 0 cases (28 failures, none in a file this diff touches). This family is owned by CI.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `39 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `check:commit-card-trailers --range` clean, and `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` `VERDICT clean exit 0`.

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/auth/src/__tests__/updateUser-return-36987.test.ts` should show 2 passing tests. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth type-check` should exit 0.
